assign_visit.description: Explicit version-checked assignment by an active dispatcher

steps.sql: UPDATE calliope_apps.northstar_visits v SET assigned_to=$2::jsonb->'technician'->>0,status=CASE WHEN status='Unassigned' THEN 'Assigned' ELSE status END,version=version+1 WHERE v.id=$2::jsonb->>'id' AND v.version=($2::jsonb->>'version')::integer AND v.status IN ('Unassigned','Assigned','Follow-up') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.northstar_staff s WHERE s.email=$1 AND s.active AND s.role='dispatcher') AND jsonb_typeof($2::jsonb->'technician')='array' AND jsonb_array_length($2::jsonb->'technician')=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.northstar_staff t WHERE t.email=$2::jsonb->'technician'->>0 AND t.active AND t.role='technician') RETURNING v.id,v.version
